name: Pronto Search UI
description: Local-only component catalog for voice search answers. Prefer one visual plus short text over text-only layouts.

components.notes: Body copy. Use [1][2] citation markers that map to source_list entries.
src must be an exact URL from the provided search results.
Only youtube.com / youtu.be URLs from search results. Rendered as youtube-nocookie embed.
open_url value must be an exact search-result URL.
Citation list. URLs must match search results exactly.
Prefer one chart when numbers compare cleanly. Invalid charts fall back to a table. DSL type=bar|line maps to chart_type.

security.urls: Only exact URLs from the search-result set. Never invent links. No raw HTML or JavaScript.
security.open_url: Opened by the Pronto backend in the default browser — never navigate the WebView.
